experiments.name: Mobile touch controls
experiments.description: Big on-screen controls on the Play page: a move stick plus JUMP, RELOAD and FIRE. This is the website preview; the game's own touch controls come with the next Web build.

experiments.name: Music tab
experiments.description: A Music button on every page that opens the soundtrack list, with every track credited to its creator.
